raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 3, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Norris Bradbury as the director of the Los Alamos project that developed the first atomic bomb; the correct director during the Manhattan Project was J. Robert Oppenheimer. This conflated postwar leadership (Bradbury) with wartime Project Y direction (Oppenheimer), sending the reasoning toward the wrong answer.
